added_claim_errors: Cites an MLIT PDF (001238428.pdf), a 全宅連 PDF, a CAA page and a courts.go.jp page as sources. These are checkable links, but I did not open them, so what they say is unverified.
「壁紙の残存価値はゼロです」 is slightly off. The standard residual value is 1円, not zero. The practical result (0円) is the same.

The email argues 7 years / 耐用年数6年 as a reason the charge is 0円. For sunburn the key says there is no liability to begin with, so depreciation is moot. A frames it as 「仮に借主負担が生じる場合でも」, so this is a minor framing issue, not a concession.
「費用対効果は十分あります」 for 少額訴訟 is an unsupported judgement. The 60万円以下 / 原則1回 facts are correct.
「壁紙（クロス）の張り替えは原則として貸主負担」 is overbroad. The guideline puts normal wear on the landlord and tenant-caused damage on the tenant, so this is not a blanket rule.
少額訴訟 「費用も数万円程度です」 is wrong. The key puts the filing fee at 3,500円 (paper) or 2,400円 (electronic) for claims up to 100,000円 from 2026-05-21, and the old fee was 1,000円 plus stamps.
「多くの場合、内訳を求められた時点で請求額は下がります」 and 「出せない請求は、根拠も怪しいことが多いです」 are unverifiable empirical claims.
Advises adding 「早期解決のため例外的に応じる」 to a pay-in-full email, saying it prevents being found to have paid 「納得して」. Whether this works legally is unverified, and it softens the main advice.
「民法90条で争える」 is a weak, unsupported add-on, though hedged as 「余地」.
Says 「判例・通説」 for the rule that wear is excluded, but cites no case or article (no 民法621条 and no 最判平成17年).

reasons: Both answers catch the baited premise in the first line and replace the 了承 email with a reply that asks for a breakdown. A is more complete and closer to the key. It cites 民法621条, says sunburn is 通常損耗 under the MLIT guideline, and says 「原状回復」 alone is not a 特約 (needs a clear clause, tenant awareness and genuine agreement). It also tells her to check the contract clause, applies 耐用年数6年 so 7 years gives 0円, demands full return of the 敷金10万円, requests 見積書 details, and advises 立会い, dated photos, not signing, 188, 法テラス and 少額訴訟. A misses the 2万円 shortfall, 622条の2 and the one-wall limit. B notes the 2万円 shortfall, but its email never demands full 敷金 return and gives no 立会い or photo advice. It is vaguer on 621条, the depreciation result and the contract-clause check, and it overstates the guideline. It also wrongly puts 少額訴訟 costs at 数万円 and suggests a questionable reservation sentence for paying anyway. Neither covers point 5. A is longer, but it is the more accurate and actionable answer.
